content: Claude Code lifecycle hooks (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, SubagentStop, Notification, UserPromptSubmit, PreCompact, SessionStart/End) are JSON-configured shell commands firing deterministically at fixed points. PostToolUse suits cleanup/format/test-on-write; Stop/SubagentStop fire on turn/subagent completion and can even block turn-end pending a check; Notification fires when Claude is waiting for input or finished a long task and is the natural hook for routing needs-human alerts to an external channel (Slack/Discord/Telegram/webhook).
